name: Mardu
description: The Mardu are a nomadic warrior clan of Tarkir, a red-white-black horde of humans, orcs, goblins and others that lives by raiding and lightning magic.

"Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

bio.text: In the original timeline the Mardu were a feared horde led by the khan Zurgo, with Sarkhan serving as a wing leader.

citations.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

"The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

bio.text: A Mardu warband raided shepherd camps and pursued an Abzan patrol, and a Temur ambush in the mountains killed a hundred Mardu.

citations.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.
"The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.
"Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

bio.text: In the new timeline Kolaghan and her brood claimed leadership of the Mardu by force, and under the dragons the clan became increasingly barbaric.

citations.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Alesha, the young Mardu khan, led the horde in ambushing dragons of Kolaghan's brood, and she was named Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

citations.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.
"The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

bio.text: Rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and began open war against Kolaghan, and the rebellion defeated her alongside the other dragonlords.

"Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After Kolaghan fell, the Mardu created a new code and swore allegiance to a new khan, and Zurgo Stormrender led them as khan.

citations.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Government". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Dragonstorm era, the clans learned to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrew the dragonlords, and the Mardu took Paala's family in.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: In the latest stories, the Mardu remain a clan of Tarkir that follows dragonstorms, with Sarkhan living in their territory.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.
Tarkir: Dragonstorm: card flavor text (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alesha wounds a dragon and Jagun knocks its head back, but then hesitates to deliver a killing blow.
timeline.quote: Alesha wounded one by letting her blade bite deep into its flank

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jagun names Alesha 'Who Smiles at Death' and the Mardu shout her name.
timeline.quote: he named her Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alesha discards the Mardu banner, declares that Kolaghan does not want to lead, and rides after the dragon with both bodyguards.
timeline.quote: She told her two bodyguards that Kolaghan did not want to lead and that her people did not have to kneel.

citation.text: "Jagun Wingmate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Kolaghan's brood lost to the clans after Ugin's death; Kolaghan smashed into the cliff at Wingthrone and her skull became the Mardu khan's throne.
timeline.quote: her skull was used as the throne of the Mardu khan

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kolaghan and her brood claim leadership over the Mardu by force, creating a new clan.
timeline.quote: She and her brood claimed leadership over the Mardu by force

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under the dragons' leadership the Mardu become increasingly barbaric.
timeline.quote: Under the leadership of the dragons, the Mardu became increasingly barbaric, forsaking what honor they had possessed before.

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Kolaghan falls, a new code is created and the council swears allegiance to the new khan.
timeline.quote: a new code was created after Kolaghan fell, and the council swore allegiance to the new khan

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Government". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A blizzard and Temur ambush kill a hundred Mardu in the mountains.
timeline.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Varuk tells Zurgo the clan no longer follows him and leads the horde back to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: the horde would follow Varuk back to Wingthrone

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The patrol finds a shepherds' summer camp destroyed, with every villager killed, and Riza orders the dead buried, fearing the horde of at least one hundred that did it.
timeline.quote: The small village lay in utter desolation. No survivors were left.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu hordechief feasts on the loot and has his advisors plan the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt.
timeline.quote: The shepherds will be moving their flocks north to the villages for winter.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief orders an immediate attack on the Abzan patrol and cuts off the tip of the quartermaster's finger when she questions him.
timeline.quote: who quickly snatched it, drew his knife, and sliced the tip off the pinky finger before she could react.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde rides through the night; the Abzan spy buzzard reports it is turning to engage and will arrive before noon.
timeline.quote: The horde has turned south to engage us,

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief hides his doubts about the gamble, believing he cannot show weakness if he wants to remain hordechief.
timeline.quote: To change course would be a sign of uncertainty.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde nears the oasis; the Abzan form a shield wall and endure a barrage of arrows.
timeline.quote: The air hummed with the flight of arrows.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu horde splits in two to attack both ends of the canyon, and the hordechief glimpses an Abzan siege elephant tower.
timeline.quote: He rose in his saddle just in time to see the tower of the Abzan siege elephant poking through the haze in the distance…

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi resolves never again to show mercy and plans to raise a vast army to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.
timeline.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
timeline.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
timeline.quote: Headtaker," Zurgo decreed.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Alesha leads the Mardu horde in an ambush of six dragons from Kolaghan's brood in a canyon.
timeline.quote: Her arrow struck the first one in the mouth, sending a stray bolt of lightning harmlessly to the ground.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Mardu warriors drop from a bluff onto the swerving dragon and two drive swords deep into its flesh.
timeline.quote: But two Mardu—two who would be celebrated this night—drove swords into its flesh

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: A towering nameless orc stuns a dragon but holds back instead of killing it, and Gedruk Wingbreaker delivers the killing blow.
timeline.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, sixteen-year-old Alesha kills her first dragon with a spear and names herself Alesha, her grandmother's name, before the old khan and the horde.
timeline.quote: she pulled a spear from a dead man's back and plunged it into the beast's mouth, up into its brain.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, the old khan and horde shout Alesha's name without hesitation.
timeline.quote: And the whole gathered horde shouted "Alesha!" in reply.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: The orc fights unorthodoxly, battering the dragon and making openings for allies, and the six dragons die at great cost.
timeline.quote: Six of Kolaghan's brood would never prey on the Mardu again.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: After the battle, Alesha hears the warriors' deeds and shouts out each new war name.
timeline.quote: she shouted the name for the horde to hear—with never a moment's hesitation.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: The orc declares he knows Alesha and names her 'Alesha, Who Smiles at Death,' and the Mardu shout her name.
timeline.quote: and I call you Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

citation.text: "The Truth of Names" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Rebel leaders raise the Mardu banner and begin open war against Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: Several rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and started the open war against Kolaghan

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rebellion grows into a formidable army and defeats Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: ultimately allowing the Mardu to defeat Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Houn tells a former Mardu that his mind must now be trained.
timeline.quote: You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong.

citation.text: Humble Defector (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
timeline.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned."

citation.text: Trumpet Blast (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
timeline.quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Wounded and humiliated, Sarkhan limps back to his hut in Mardu territory, mourning his lost power.
timeline.quote: He walked for hours from the Crucible to the cold fields of Mardu territory.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala remembers how a Mardu hunting party found her family and took them in, and how her mother came to tend their manul kittens.
timeline.quote: a Mardu hunting party that had been tasked with scouting and following the storm had stumbled across the three of them

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Emina and the elders affirm that Paala reached the lightning first and was kind to her peers.
timeline.quote: Paala was the first to reach the summit,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
timeline.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Temur ambush the Mardu from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu; Zurgo hands out battle names to newly blooded warriors and Batar angrily challenges him.
timeline.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Riza's patrol found a shepherds' summer camp burned by Mardu with no survivors.
timeline.quote: ravaged and burned to the ground by Mardu

citation.text: "Ogan Shieldmender", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The larger Abzan patrol arrived with a siege elephant as the Mardu converged.
timeline.quote: The larger patrol was coming.

citation.text: "Ogan Shieldmender", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Riza's patrol found a shepherds' camp burned by the Mardu and followed the horde.
timeline.quote: one of the shepherds' summer camps had been ravaged and burned to the ground by Mardu with not a single survivor

citation.text: "Riza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Mardu converged, an Abzan siege elephant of the larger patrol appeared.
timeline.quote: The larger patrol was coming.

citation.text: "Riza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mardu capture the Abzan city of Sandsteppe Gate.
timeline.quote: A former Abzan city that has since been captured by the Mardu.

citation.text: "Sandsteppe", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Zurgo mobilizes the horde to hunt Sarkhan in Temur lands and suffers heavy losses.
timeline.quote: Zurgo mobilized the horde to hunt Sarkhan down

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The horde deserts Zurgo under Varuk.
timeline.quote: the rest of the horde deserted him afterward under the command of his former second, Varuk

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the fall of Kolaghan, Zurgo Stormrender leads the Mardu as khan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo Stormrender now leads the Mardu as khan

citation.text: "Zurgo", section "Khan once more". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: I came seeking a challenge.

citation.text: Utter End (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

relations.note: She plans to march on the Mardu with an undead army.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

relations.note: The dragon the Mardu revere for speed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.
